# Knowledge Base: sum-of-kth-powers-oq-04-incomplete-01

## Problem Understanding

The target is the convergence of the normalized power sum `sum_{i=0}^{n-1} i^k / n^{k+1}` to `1/(k+1)`, i.e. the Riemann sum for `x^k` on `[0,1]`.

The parent gallery proof is `sum-of-kth-powers-oq-04`. The local notes say it provides the foundation, with one sorry for the main asymptotics and one axiom for Bernoulli polynomial leading behavior.

## Insights

Suggested proof directions from the local problem notes are a squeeze theorem or comparison with integrals. Another candidate is applying Mathlib's `MeasureTheory.integral_pow` through a Riemann sum approximation.

## Dead Ends

No dead ends are recorded in the local notes.
